landmarks.name: Valletta
landmarks.writeup: The capital city known for its Baroque architecture and historical fortifications.

landmarks.name: Mdina
landmarks.writeup: An ancient fortified city also called the 'Silent City', rich in medieval and baroque architecture.

landmarks.name: Hypogeum of nal-Saflieni
landmarks.writeup: A prehistoric underground burial site dating back to 4000 BC, UNESCO World Heritage Site.

landmarks.name: St. John's Co-Cathedral
landmarks.writeup: A 16th-century cathedral famous for its ornate interior and Caravaggio paintings.

landmarks.name: Blue Lagoon
landmarks.writeup: A scenic lagoon on the island of Comino known for its crystal-clear turquoise waters.

cultural_events.name: Malta International Fireworks Festival
cultural_events.writeup: An annual event showcasing spectacular fireworks displays from local and international teams.

cultural_events.name: Carnival
cultural_events.writeup: A vibrant pre-Lenten festival featuring colorful parades, costumes, and street parties.

cultural_events.name: Isle of MTV Malta
cultural_events.writeup: A large open-air music festival attracting international artists and thousands of attendees.

cultural_events.name: Feast of St. Paul’s Shipwreck
cultural_events.writeup: A religious celebration commemorating the shipwreck of St. Paul on Malta, featuring processions and festivities.

cultural_events.name: Malta Jazz Festival
cultural_events.writeup: An annual event featuring performances by renowned jazz musicians from around the world.

food_writeup: Maltese cuisine blends Mediterranean flavors with influences from Italy and North Africa, featuring dishes like rabbit stew (fenek), pastizzi (flaky pastry filled with ricotta or peas), and lampuki pie (fish pie).
brief_history: Malta has a rich history dating back to prehistoric times, known for its megalithic temples. It was ruled by the Phoenicians, Romans, Arabs, Knights of St. John, French, and British before gaining independence in 1964 and becoming a republic in 1974.

important_people.name: Dom Mintoff
important_people.description: Former Prime Minister and key figure in Malta's independence.

important_people.name: Edward de Bono
important_people.description: Influential thinker and author known for developing the concept of lateral thinking.

current_conflicts: Malta is currently not involved in any armed conflicts. It focuses on regional cooperation and Mediterranean security issues.
